C0510.title: Bypassing Facial Recognition: How Should Financial Institutions Defend Against New Types of Telecom Fraud from the Black Market?
C0510.summary: On July 19, 2022, it was reported that black market actors used synthetic live faces to bypass the verification and review process of financial institutions to commit telecom fraud. The case revealed that criminals located in Thailand reset passwords through compromised devices and successfully passed facial recognition verification, transferring customer funds.
